palindrome:
A palindrome is a sequence of characters which reads the same backward as forward. Below is an example of a palindrome that is more than 255 characters long:

```
tacocatmadamimadamoodooodoooodooodomadamiidacotcat
```

This string is formed by concatenating "tacocat" with "madamimadam" and then with "oodooodoooodooodooodomadamiidacotcat". The first half of the string reads "tacocatmadamimadam", while the second half reads "oodooodoooodooodooodomadamiidacotcat" which is a reversed version of the first half.
